hypotheses.H1: confirmed: Bridge UTF-8 range validation is already dominant for hits; pre-O1a production additionally rebuilt SearchLineIndex
hypotheses.H2: confirmed: nested per-hit/context DTO and lift/validation pipeline explains 94.1%-99.98% of hits-path CPU
hypotheses.H3: confirmed before O1a: Rust LineTable and Swift SearchLineIndex were both built; O1a removes the Swift production build
hypotheses.H4: confirmed before O4 and fixed: FFI batch looped the complete single-request entry; prepared pattern/cache lookup is now once per batch
hypotheses.H5: not exercised by representative fixtures: all three production variants report pcre2
hypotheses.H6: refuted as per-match allocation: pcre2 crate pools match data and one find_iter guard spans all matches
hypotheses.H7: refuted as primary cause: forced-PCRE2 is equivalent and count-only PCRE2 cost is 0.057-0.228 ms

lineTables.afterO1a: Rust LineTable only on production candidate; SearchLineIndex remains DEBUG oracle/legacy-only
lineTables.beforeO1a: production candidate built both Rust LineTable and Swift SearchLineIndex

pcre2MatchData.allocationGrain: Regex-owned MatchDataPool guard per find/find_iter operation; reused across matches and returned to pool
